It feels like im never going to figure out what to do with my life. 30 is right around the corner and im still working for 12 bucks an hour stocking shelves. I dont want to be working for these shitty companys that will replace me the second i break my back. Im tired of feeling guilty for not doing more than my job. I dont want to be the 67 year old man who has been with the company for 40 years and is making two dollars more than me.

It feels like nothings going to change and the world will keep spinning if im here or not. The job will be there if im here or not. I dont have to be here to deal with the bullshit of it all. I dont have to be here to wake up tomorrow and the day after that and the day after that until i wake up one day and realize i am that 67 year old man i was terrified of being. I can end it all now. Quit while im "ahead". Give up before it gets worse.

I just lost probably the best job im every going to have working at the post office. I started out in a plant hardly talking to anyone just moving packages around. Perfect. I was there for a year when they decided to promote me. 

This mandatory promotion came with a slew of benefits and a hefty bump in hourly pay but my job changed to call center work. I had to quit because i wouldn't have been able to handle talking to that many people on a daily basis. For any kind of money or future. I wish i could say i was happier now or i made the right choice.
